_about: THE glucose sources (docs/44 'Person x Source', #213): whose glucose a device shows ('persons') x where it comes from
('sources'). Each source declares what it can do; the apps read these declarations, not the id, to group the
picker, word the Source page and key behaviour. A source is per device (never mirrored). 'persons' = whose glucose it
may bring; 'platforms' = the apps that offer it; 'firstHand' = this device gets the data itself (not relayed by
another Sukrara); 'offline' = works without internet; 'group' = how the picker groups it (what the person feels:
offline / network / online / sukrara); 'delay_s' = typical time from the sensor's reading to this device; 'backfill' = it
brings readings missed while away; 'brings' = what it brings besides glucose; 'readings' = the reading source ids it
stores (dedup.json ranks them; LibreLinkUp's live reading and its graph points are two ids, so the graph only fills
gaps). 'keying' = what each (person, source, Settings from) gets, the cases every app's
SourceSpec passes: 'owner' = this device owns your glucose (shares it with Sukrara followers, uploads it, insulin
pens, sensor reminders, Import history); 'stream' = a Sukrara stream (Settings from, escalation, writer scope, the
Following rows); 'alertRole' = the alert engine's role (WEARER / FOLLOWER_MIRROR / FOLLOWER_OWN, unchanged from the
roles it replaces). 'invalid' = pairs no app offers. A person change deletes this device's readings and treatments
(confirmed first); a source change keeps them. 'life' = what it says of the sensor's life (docs/44 decision 10,
contracts/sources/sensor-life.json): 'full' = its start and length (the sensor itself; another Sukrara relays
its wearer's), 'start' = the start but not the length, 'maybeStart' = a start only when one is logged (a Nightscout
site's Sensor Start), 'none' = nothing (later: Dexcom Share, an official app's notification). 'wear' = the schema
setting holding the wear length of a source that doesn't say it (null for 'full'): one per source, remembered
across sensors. A manual start (schema sensor.manualStart) is offered for 'maybeStart' and 'none', your glucose only.

invalid.why: a sensor Sukrara reads is on this device's own person
